description: Synthetic evidence scenarios for agent guidance, not collector lookup rules. Empty categories mean non-personal only within the stated context; unresolved examples require more evidence.

examples.context: Account holder supplies their own display name; profile rendering displays it as that individual name.
Catalog label supplied by a merchant; product lookup and checkout use it as the item label, not as a person name.
Account key used to retrieve an individual customer profile and attribute their orders.
Catalog SKU record key used only to select a product. The same item can be purchased by many unrelated customers.
References an individual customer profile and attributes the order to that person.
References the catalog item. It does not identify the purchaser; that association is carried separately by the order.
Only the primary-key declaration is available; lookup, correlation and person attribution have not been investigated.
Customer supplies the city of their own delivery address, which fulfillment uses to deliver to that person.
The city of a corporate warehouse used for inventory routing, with no individual address or personal attribution.
Timestamp emitted on successful individual login and displayed in that account authentication history.
Planned background maintenance execution time; scheduling is system-driven and does not record an individual action.
Requester email supplied for replying to their support ticket. An operational purpose does not change the address meaning.
